title: Part Eight: Where the Argument Breaks

sections.brief: Four tests: Singapore and Dubai as claimed models (Land p.6 quoted passage; Kofman) vs Freedom House 2026 (48 and 18), PAP succession 15 May 2024, Geddes-Wright-Frantz typology; personalist penalty (Blattman, Gehlbach, Yu, NBER w34093) and corruption (Kostadinova & Neshkova 2025), primogeniture counterpoint (Kokkonen & Sundell); Enron and FTX caught by outside state; VOC and East India Company corrected by Parliament and the Dutch state. Figures: compare; time

Who removes a bad CEO-sovereign: Land's Hobbesian premise that sovereignty cannot be caged turned against the charter; Yarvin's secret board with cryptographic keys to disarm weapons (Kofman, untested); Compact critique; Hirschman exit/voice vs 'No voice, free exit'; Federalist 51, impeachment, 22nd Amendment, Trump v. Slaughter; worst-case reading tested for Book One (end state documented; adoption not supported here, pointed to Books II-III). Figures: flow; compare
